name: Verzekeringsbank Kosmos, Koningsplein 1
surveyedSource: 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell of BAG pand 0363100012176247 (3DBAG CC BY 4.0, BAG CC0) in native east/south metres (scripts/landmarks/koningsplein-1-footprints.json, bag-shell-prepare.ts) for the hipped roof, its glazed strip and the party walls; the round corner tower drawn on a circle fitted to the BAG corner (centre 0.167, 0.503; radius 2.32 m). Fronts, tower and dome read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas rectified onto the wall planes at 40 px/m: b_20250109_1300_Track05_Sphere_00277 (2025, Koningsplein), recording_2025-06-19_03-28-47_01535 (2025, the tower) and recording_2025-06-19_03-28-47_01537 (2025, the Singel side), with TMX7316010203-002542_pano_0004_000309 (2022) for the brief crop; CC BY 4.0, heights fitted to the 3DBAG cornice (17.5 m). Rijksmonument 518359 (register text: Th.G. Schill and D.H. Haverkamp, 1890-91, neo-baroque, for the Verzekeringsbank 'Kosmos'; tower crown altered 1928; shop front H. Elte 1929-30). Per wall in scripts/landmarks/koningsplein-1-inventory.json.

attribution.title: Koningsplein 1, Amsterdam: shop and offices of the Verzekeringsbank 'Kosmos' (Th.G. Schill and D.H. Haverkamp, 1890-91; rijksmonument 518359)
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012176247 (CC0): the round corner tower with its balcony, VERZEKERINGSBANK frieze, stone drum, helmet dome and open lantern; red brick with sandstone speklagen; stone-framed windows, consoles and iron-railed balconies, pedimented French windows, paired round-arched top-storey windows between Ionic pilasters, the light-blue console frieze and cornice; the black granite shop front with its clerestories and mosaic tableaux, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0) and the RCE register text. No pixels or meshes imported.
